sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.

sentences.en: As the Delta variant rages across the U.S., the focus has turned to the estimated 90 million people who are eligible for the vaccine, but have chosen not to get it.
sentences.zh: 随着德尔塔变异株全美肆虐，焦点转向了估计有9万万符合接种条件却选择不接种的人群。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues spoke to some of those people.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事采访了其中一些人。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月6日，星期五。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: Because I've been told all day long that my voice is fading in and out.
sentences.zh: 因为他们一整天都跟我说我的声音时大时小。

sentences.en: No, I got you.
sentences.zh: 听得到，我听得清。

sentences.en: Okay, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Let me tell you what kind of trouble we're trying to get into here.
sentences.zh: 我先说说我们这次想探究什么样的问题。

sentences.en: So we are, we meaning like a fleet of reporters at the New York
sentences.zh: 我们，也就是《纽约时报》的一群记者，

sentences.en: Times, are interviewing a lot of people across America to really understand the complexity of their reasons for not being vaccinated at this point.
sentences.zh: 正在采访全美各地的许多人，以真正了解他们至今仍未接种疫苗的复杂原因。

sentences.en: So we're trying to really look at what's thinking, you know, what are the social pressures on people at this point?
sentences.zh: 所以我们试图探究他们的想法，你知道，大家现在面临怎样的社会压力？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: My colleague Jan Hoffman spoke with Don Driscoll, a 38-year-old single dad living in suburban Pittsburgh.
sentences.zh: 我的同事简·霍夫曼采访了唐·德里斯科尔，他是一位住在匹兹堡郊区的38岁单亲爸爸。

sentences.en: So tell me, before we sort of take a deep dive into vaccines, tell me a little bit about yourself, DJ.
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我，在我们深入探讨疫苗之前，先简单介绍一下你自己吧，DJ。

sentences.en: What's your full name, or do you go by DJ?
sentences.zh: 你的全名是什么，还是大家都叫你 DJ？

sentences.en: Okay, and what sort of work do you do?
sentences.zh: 好的，你是从事什么工作的？

sentences.en: Do you live on your own?
sentences.zh: 你一个人住吗？

sentences.en: I, me and my daughter.
sentences.zh: 我，我和我女儿。

sentences.en: I have a seven-year-old that I have a primary custody of.
sentences.zh: 我有一个七岁的孩子，我是主要抚养人。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What is your view of other vaccines, particularly vis-a-vis your daughter?
sentences.zh: 你对其他疫苗怎么看，尤其是考虑到你女儿的情况？

sentences.en: Yeah, I've, I've got them.
sentences.zh: 对，我，我都接种过。

sentences.en: She's, so.
sentences.zh: 她，所以。

sentences.en: Do you get the flu vaccine?
sentences.zh: 你打过流感疫苗吗？

sentences.en: I do not.
sentences.zh: 我没打过。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Okay, so tell me, you know, your evolving thoughts about this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么告诉我，你对这款疫苗的想法是怎样演变的。

sentences.en: I am personally, I'm not one of, I kind of.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，我不是那种，我有点像。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: You know, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有意思。

sentences.en: It almost sounds, you know, and tell me if I'm, I'm getting this wrong.
sentences.zh: 听起来几乎是，如果我理解得不对请纠正我。

sentences.en: It's almost as if the sensibility is, I don't want to jump, but I'm willing to be pushed.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是这种心态：我不想主动去打，但如果别人推我一把我也愿意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah, and not me.
sentences.zh: 对，但我不行。

sentences.en: So in your view, like you say, you just want to hang back and wait.
sentences.zh: 所以在你看来，就像你说的，你只想观望和等待。

sentences.en: So do you have any sort of benchmarks in your head?
sentences.zh: 那你心里有什么标准吗？

sentences.en: Well, if they say this, then I do it, or, you know, I guess basically the question is, what would it take aside from, you know, you have to get it to travel?
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果他们这么说，那我就去打，或者，我想基本的问题是，除了“为了旅行你必须接种”之外，还需要什么条件？

sentences.en: Yeah, but right now it's just like that.
sentences.zh: 对，但现在就是这种情况。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Do you identify with any particular political party in how you vote?
sentences.zh: 你在投票时认同某个特定的政党吗？

sentences.en: Uh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 呃，对。

sentences.en: I'm definitely, like, fiscally conservative.
sentences.zh: 我绝对是那种财政保守派。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But.
sentences.zh: 但是。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Did you vote for Trump in the, in the last election?
sentences.zh: 你在上届大选中投给特朗普了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah, no, no, it's an Xbox decision.
sentences.zh: 对，不，不，这就像买 Xbox 一样是个决定。

sentences.en: I totally get it.
sentences.zh: 我完全理解。

sentences.en: Maybe I don't have the greatest metaphor.
sentences.zh: 也许我的比喻不太好。

sentences.en: It's just constantly changing.
sentences.zh: 情况总是在不断变化。

sentences.en: Just wait and make all the decisions at once.
sentences.zh: 那就等事情一起做决定吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I had a flu shot when I was younger.
sentences.zh: 我年轻时打过流感疫苗。

sentences.en: And that was the worSt. I was sick.
sentences.zh: 那可太糟糕了。我病得很厉害。

sentences.en: Like, really bad.
sentences.zh: 真的非常严重。

sentences.en: Fever for a few days.
sentences.zh: 发烧了好几天。

sentences.en: I've been, like, four days straight.
sentences.zh: 连续四天都是这样。

sentences.en: So that right there just kind of, you know, had me alone.
sentences.zh: 所以经历过那次之后，你知道的，就让我敬而远之了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I'm not getting my vaccine.
sentences.zh: 我想，我是绝不会去打这针疫苗的。

sentences.en: Angelique White is a 28-year-old hairstylist living outside Detroit, Michigan.
sentences.zh: 安杰莉克·怀特是住在密歇根州底特律郊外的一名28岁美发师。

sentences.en: My boyfriend, he had got the vaccine, and he's, like, trying to push it on me.
sentences.zh: 我男朋友打了疫苗，他一直在劝我也去打。

sentences.en: Like, he's just going to get the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 就像，他马上就要去打了。

sentences.en: You work around people and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 你的工作周围要接触各种人诸如此类的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 而我说，我不在乎。

sentences.en: Wear my mask and, you know, just sanitize my hands and do it like that.
sentences.zh: 戴好口罩，你知道的，勤洗手消毒，就这样过。

sentences.en: I think
sentences.zh: 我想

sentences.en: I'll be fine.
sentences.zh: 我会没事的。

sentences.en: Even today, you know, if you were to be vaccinated, you still have to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 即使在今天，你知道的，如果你接种了疫苗，你仍然得戴口罩。

sentences.en: And then even if you're getting the vaccine, you still can get sick from it.
sentences.zh: 而且就算你打了疫苗，你还是可能会因此生病。

sentences.en: So, me personally, I'm not getting in on my kids.
sentences.zh: 所以就我个人而言，我不会给我的孩子们打。

sentences.en: So, tell me, Jeannie, where have I reached you?
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我，珍妮，我联系到你时你在哪里？

sentences.en: Just tell me, what part of the country are we?
sentences.zh: 告诉我，我们在国家的哪个部位？

sentences.en: I'm in Colorado, 20 miles south of Denver.
sentences.zh: 我在科罗拉多州，在丹佛以南20英里处。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: I've been there.
sentences.zh: 我去过那儿。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, tell me a little bit, how old are you?
sentences.zh: 那么告诉我，你多大了？

sentences.en: You know, the whole drill.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是这些常规情况。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So, and I have a 14-year-old son who's almost 15 in a couple months, and he's going to be starting high school.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有一个14岁的儿子，几个月后就快15岁了，他马上要上高中了。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then it's my husband, who's 40.
sentences.zh: 然后还有我40岁的丈夫。

sentences.en: And then I also live with my mom, who's 64.
sentences.zh: 然后我还和64岁的母亲住在一起。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And do you work outside the home, or are you full-time homekeeper?
sentences.zh: 你在家外面工作，还是全职家庭主妇？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm a teacher.
sentences.zh: 对，我是一名老师。

sentences.en: So, I'm home right now, but part-time, like, since COVID started, basically.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在在家，但基本上从新冠疫情开始就是兼职了。

sentences.en: So, what do you teach?
sentences.zh: 那你教什么？

sentences.en: How old are the kids?
sentences.zh: 孩子们多大？

sentences.en: Middle school, math.
sentences.zh: 初中数学。

sentences.en: Oh, God bless you.
sentences.zh: 哦，上帝保佑你。

sentences.en: So, is anyone in your household vaccinated?
sentences.zh: 那么你家里有人接种过疫苗吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm anti-vaccine, period.
sentences.zh: 我是反疫苗主义者，没商量。

sentences.en: So, I'm a very healthy person.
sentences.zh: 所以我是一个非常健康的人。

sentences.en: I'm vegan.
sentences.zh: 我是素食主义者。

sentences.en: I eat really well.
sentences.zh: 我饮食非常健康。

sentences.en: I work out.
sentences.zh: 我健身。

sentences.en: I take really good care of myself.
sentences.zh: 我把自己照顾得很好。

sentences.en: I have, I was vaccinated when I was younger.
sentences.zh: 我，我年轻时接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: I originally am from Russia, so I came to the United States when I was seven.
sentences.zh: 我原本来自俄罗斯，所以我七岁时来到了美国。

sentences.en: When I came here at seven, I was vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我七岁来到这里时，是接种过疫苗的。

sentences.en: I think to come from Russia to here, we needed to be vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我想从俄罗斯来这里，我们必须接种疫苗。

sentences.en: I got pretty sick.
sentences.zh: 我病得挺重的。

sentences.en: And since then, I have not been vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，我就再没接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: My son has never been vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我儿子从来没接种过任何疫苗。

sentences.en: So, I'm an anti-vaccine.
sentences.zh: 所以我是一个反疫苗主义者。

sentences.en: So, tell me something.
sentences.zh: 所以，告诉我一件事。

sentences.en: If I heard you correctly, I think you said that your son has never been vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 如果我没听错的话，我想你说过你儿子从来没有接种过疫苗。

sentences.en: Is it with anything?
sentences.zh: 任何疫苗都没有吗？

sentences.en: Nope, nothing.
sentences.zh: 对，什么都没有。

sentences.en: And so, what was that like for you getting into the school system?
sentences.zh: 那你是怎么应对进入学校系统的呢？

sentences.en: You know, they're, now it's, they are making it harder now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们，现在他们把这卡得更严了。

sentences.en: But when it was at first, it wasn't, you know, you just have to say it's for reasons.
sentences.zh: 但一开始的时候并不是这样，你知道的，你只需要说明是出于某些原因。

sentences.en: Like, I just signed papers, and we've never had a problem with it, ever.
sentences.zh: 比如，我只是签了文件，我们从来没有遇到过任何问题，一次也没有。

sentences.en: And he's, like I said, he's going into high school, and he never had a problem with it.
sentences.zh: 而且正如我所说，他现在要上高中了，也从来没遇到过问题。

sentences.en: So, did you have to?
sentences.zh: 所以，你必须？

sentences.en: I imagine it's going to be harder now.
sentences.zh: 我想现在会更难吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: You know, it's not, it's going to be more of a problem now.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这不会，现在这会成为更多的问题。

sentences.en: So, is any of your reasoning also faith-based?
sentences.zh: 所以你的一部分理由也是基于信仰吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I mean, it's based on the fact that I just think that vaccines are toxic things that don't need to go into your body.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是基于这样一个事实：我只是认为疫苗是毒物，不需要进入你的身体。

sentences.en: So, let me ask you this.
sentences.zh: 那我问你这个。

sentences.en: You know, if any kind of mandates come down, I don't know, I'm making this up because I have no idea.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果出台了任何形式的强制令，我不知道，我这是瞎编的因为我完全不知道。

sentences.en: So, like, let's just say your school said, you know, you can't come to work without being vaccinated, or.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如说，假设你们学校说，你知道的，不打疫苗就不能来上班，或者。

sentences.en: I need to find another job.
sentences.zh: 那我得去找另一份工作。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to figure out.
sentences.zh: 我只是想弄清楚。

sentences.en: I'm 100% serious.
sentences.zh: 我百分之百认真。

sentences.en: Yeah, I get it.
sentences.zh: 行，我明白。

sentences.en: I'm not going to have anybody tell me I need to get vaccinated.
sentences.zh: 我不需要任何人来告诉我我去打疫苗。

sentences.en: They have no idea what my history is, what the medical reasoning is, or it's really none of anybody's business.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道我的病史是什么，医学理由是什么，或者说这压根不关任何人的事。

sentences.en: My body's strong.
sentences.zh: 我的身体很强壮。

sentences.en: I mean, gosh, if I'm meant to die from it, then, you know, I'm going to die.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，天哪，如果注定要因此而死，那，你知道的，我死就死了。

sentences.en: But I really don't believe that.
sentences.zh: 但我真的不这么认为。

sentences.en: So, I actually cold-heartedly believe that I have more of a shot of getting sick or something happening to me by taking the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 所以，我非常冷酷地坚信，比起接种疫苗，我因为生病或其他意外而发生不幸的几率反而更高。

sentences.en: The thing that I worry about is really my kids, because when they go back to school, those kids who are vaccinated don't have to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 我真正担心的是我的孩子们，因为他们返校后，那些接种过疫苗的孩子不用戴口罩。

sentences.en: And the kids that are not vaccinated, you know, are going to have to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 而那些没接种疫苗的孩子，你知道的，就必须戴口罩。

sentences.en: Everybody's going to have to know.
sentences.zh: 所有人都会知道。

sentences.en: And I do worry about that.
sentences.zh: 我是真的有点担心这个。

sentences.en: I'll be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 说实话。

sentences.en: I had a talk with him, and I said, ultimately, it's your decision, because I get it.
sentences.zh: 我和他聊过，我说，归根结底，这是你的决定，因为我理解。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: I hope he doesn't do it, because I've worked so hard on keeping him where he's out and not having masks and being as healthy as he can possibly be, in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我希望他不要去打，因为我为了让他保持现状、不用戴口罩、并且在我看来尽可能保持健康，付出了太多的努力。

sentences.en: So, I hope he makes that decision, but I'm not going to make it difficult for him if he, you know, is struggling with a mask, or he thinks that's what he needs to do.
sentences.zh: 所以，我希望他能做那个决定，但如果他，你知道的，觉得戴口罩很艰难，或者他认为那就是他需要做的，我也不会为难他。

sentences.en: And so, just so I understand with your son, did you tell him he had a choice about whether to wear a mask or whether to get vaccinated?
sentences.zh: 所以，为了让我理解你儿子的状况，你告诉过他，他可以选择是戴口罩还是去接种疫苗吗？

sentences.en: Well, the school's not going to give him a choice to wear a mask or not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，学校可不会给他选择戴不戴口罩的余地。

sentences.en: If he's not vaccinated, he's going to have to wear a mask.
sentences.zh: 如果他没接种疫苗，他就必须戴口罩。

sentences.en: So, yes, I told him that, let's see how the school year starts.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我告诉过他，我们先看看新学期开始情况怎么样。

sentences.en: If it's really bad, if it's really bothering you, we can make a decision what you want to do.
sentences.zh: 如果真的很糟糕，如果真的让你很困扰，我们可以再决定你想怎么做。

sentences.en: But, like I said, he knows the reasoning behind you.
sentences.zh: 但是，就像我说的，他知道你这么想的原因。

sentences.en: You know, he's never fought me on it before, but, you know, when your choices are taken away, when you're going to have a harder time in school
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他以前从没在这事上跟我争过，但是，当你的选择被剥夺，当你在学校里

sentences.en: because of it, then, you know, he's in there all day.

sentences.zh: 由丽莎·周和MJ·戴维斯-林恩剪辑，克里斯·伍德进行工程制作，并包含丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目获取让客人宾至如归的技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会晕厥过去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢收听的任何地方查找《Wirecutter秀》。
